scope: Manual inspection of four derived figures. Other figures checked for file integrity and dimensions during publication audit.
observations: A and D body skeletons nearly overlap after the extended budget while both deviate from GT at pelvis/lower limbs.
Both D camera overlays retain visible elbow/lower-body marker offsets, hand-shape and body-surface mismatches. Keypoint similarity does not establish silhouette or collision correctness.
Training objective curves approach similar values; held-out GT body errors are not monotonic with optimization budget.
Legends readable, charts at 1280x720; side skeleton axes use equal metric aspect.
